lead.event: DMAS announces Rp1.4 trillion interim dividend
lead.headline: DMAS plans Rp1.4 trillion interim dividend
lead.blurb: The proposed 2026 fiscal-year payout is Rp29 per share, equal to 93.75% of net profit as of September. Puradelta Lestari’s net profit rose 284% to Rp1.49 trillion, while revenue climbed 3.4-fold to Rp2.65 trillion, mostly from industrial land sales to the data center sector.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: EMAS plans a private placement of up to 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS plans private placement of up to 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Gold's proposed issuance could equal up to 10% of fully paid-up capital and dilute existing shareholders by up to 9.091%. Each share has a nominal value of Rp150, with about 25% of proceeds for working capital and the remainder available for business development or debt repayment. Independent shareholders vote on 26 November.
